Passive.description: Fixed period defining passive background industrial sensor register sampling loops.

Active.description: High-priority safety-interlock command triggered dynamically to isolate a reactor sector.

Dynamic.description: Continuous precise angular feedback of the cooling valve position (Real-time Industrial Stream).

Location.description: Absolute indoor spatial zone mapping the specific reactor room and physical control panel segment.

Equipment.description: Hardware physical topology configuration parameters detailing the processor rack position and model code.

Status.description: Physical orientation state of the manual hardware toggle switch (RUN mode vs STOP mode).

User.description: Cryptographic signature or identity tag of the engineer uploading updated ladder logic control loops.

Operational.description: Program execution cycle time, serving as a critical metric for detecting firmware fuzzing/tampering.

Service.description: State parameters of the closed-loop PID control algorithm managing critical thermal fluidics.

RFID.description: Cryptographic supply chain ledger entry tracked via on-board component RFID to verify against counterfeiting.

Historical.description: Database log tracking historical physical shielding inspections and software patch versions.

Spectrum.description: Error packet counters, framing errors, and transmission statistics on the Profinet interface.

Environmental.description: Real-time surrounding radiation dose rate measured in Sieverts to detect system degradation.
